content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Overview ## slug: payments-set-up-paylink-overview ## seoTitle: Overview ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (For Government Cloud Users) Government Cloud users who want to use PayLink need to reach out to {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to have instanceUrl added to their PayLink license. ::: * * * :::(Info) (Do I need to install PayLink?) PayLink does not need to be installed separately. It was already installed via the Candy Shop. ::: {{variable.Product_PayLink}} is our beautiful, mobile-responsive payment request, paid add-on. For every {{variable.Object_Transaction}} that's created, a unique link (PayLink) is created. The link can be rolled up to your {{variable.Object_Transaction}}'s parent record, such as an {{variable.Object_Opportunity}} record. The link can also be automatically emailed to your customer so they can make an immediate payment. ![L_01_Paylink pic 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/L_01_Paylink%20pic%201.png){height="" width=""} Check out this quick 2-minute video to see it in action! [Blackthorn Payments - PayLink Overview](https://youtu.be/YYVulOejREQ?si=_uqc89YdD_dx9Rre){target="_blank"} Quick Tip: You can create multiple PayLink configurations to change the look and feel of payment requests!
